Thanks Elaine — great, confirmed for Wed 10/14 10am PT. Per your asks, attaching an updated slice of our model and a short summary below so we can use the call to validate assumptions rather than build from scratch.

Quick unit-economics summary (pre-call):
- Assumptions (please flag if you want changes):
  * Personalization: 1.2M req/day, 80 tokens/req => ~96M tokens/day (real-time).
  * Summarization: 60M tokens/day (batch).
  * Total tokens/day = ~156M tokens => ~4.68B tokens/month.
- Pricing bands (Redwood suggested for production):
  * Tier A: $1,500 / 1M tokens (volume > 2B/mo)
  * Tier B: $1,900 / 1M tokens (volume 500M–2B/mo)
  * POC: $2,200 / 1M tokens (trial, <3 months)
- Example monthly inference cost (@ Tier A): 4.68B tokens / 1M * $1,500 = $7,020,000 / month.

Per-feature breakdown (example):
1) Real-time personalization (assumes 65% of uplifted conversions attributable to personalization):
   - Monthly tokens: 96M * 30 = 2.88B => cost @ Tier A = $4,320,000 / month
   - If personalization drives an incremental $0.50 ARPU per MAU and you have 350k MAU, incremental revenue = $175,000 / month.
   - That puts inference cost far above revenue in this naive example — clearly we need to refine attribution and expected ARPU uplift or scope.

2) Nightly summarization (compliance / retention):
   - Monthly tokens: 60M * 30 = 1.8B => cost @ Tier A = $2,700,000 / month
   - This is a compliance-only feature (no direct ARPU uplift) so you'd want to bundle cost into platform fees or seek more efficient batch/quantization.

Observations / recommendations for the call:
- The baseline numbers show inference cost is large vs. current ARPU assumptions. We should test smaller rollout surfaces first (e.g., personalization for high-LTV cohort only or sampling) to improve $/feature.
- Quantization and batching can reduce inference CPU/GPU cost per token by 30–60% — Aditya, can you prepare a short slide on quantization options and expected $/1M token delta?
- We'll model CAC payback scenarios on the call. Typical benchmarks: to keep inference <20% of gross margin for a $5–$10 ARPU uplift, you need aggressive cohort gating or higher ARPU assumptions.

Attached: updated fintechx_token_estimates.xlsx (sheets: summary, per_flow), redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.pdf

See you Wed —
Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
